A full clone is a complete copy of the original virtual machine at its current state. The virtual machine is fully independent and requires more disk space to store.||完整克隆是原始虚拟机当前状态的完整副本。该虚拟机完全独立，需要更多磁盘空间来存储。

A linked clone is a reference to the original virtual machine and requires less disk space to store. However, it cannot run without access to the original virtual machine.||链接克隆是对原始虚拟机的引用，占用的磁盘空间更少。但它必须在能够访问原始虚拟机的情况下才能运行。

This guest OS requires a virtual TPM (Trusted Platform Module).

The data for the virtual TPM must be encrypted with a password. Make sure to write down this password in a secure location. You will not be able to use this virtual machine without it.||此客户机操作系统需要虚拟 TPM（可信平台模块）。

虚拟 TPM 的数据必须使用密码加密。请务必将此密码记录在安全的位置。没有它你将无法使用此虚拟机。
